$Comment: The way into Christmas: go and find Santa in the Forgotten Temple. It arms itself: Flow.AutoAccept
puts it in every player's quest log while Christmas runs, at their next login or world change, and the
base's Flow.AutoTrack pins it to their tracker. The _Christmas folder makes the id
christmas_santa_meet.
The one step is a TURN_IN with a blank Target, handed in at the giver: nothing to bring, only the
walk. Santa's conversation opens on his arrival line while it is carried, and its answer hands it in.
Its pay is a Claim like every quest's, so the hand-in takes the player to his quest list with Collect
in front of them; collecting it plays his conversation again, and its beat with the OnceId
christmas_meet_thieves_offer opens on his first quest's offer. A player whose quest log was full when
it tried to arm takes it from the same arrival line, through its quest row.
Its Parent's Season hides it while Christmas is off, so its own Requires holds only the Not group,
which keeps it from anyone who already finished his first quest (christmas_present_thieves). With no
Repeat it comes once per player, ever. His first quest does not wait on it: a player without it still
gets the story from Santa.
The Item row hands over the library's Objective Book, the way into every quest and achievement list,
so a player whose first season is Christmas, or a server with this pack and no MMO Skill Tree, has a
way to get one; a player who already holds one gets a second. The Currency rows pay a few Christmas
Coins, so a new player has something to spend at the Christmas stalls, and a few festival tokens.
Beside them, MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row pays Acrobatics XP for the walk to the temple, collected
with the rest. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server
without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest still pays.
Name: Santa_Meet
